env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
stdout '^anon 1 1 1 1$'
stdout '^nested 3$'
stdout '^empty 0 0 1$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

mkdir $WORK/orig
cp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! grep '"comptime"' out/main.go
! grep 'col:' out/main.go

cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

cmp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectctas

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Row struct {
	N int64 `row:"n"`
}

func Count[T any]() int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f.Name
		n++
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("anon",
		Count[struct {
			N int64 `col:"n"`
		}](),
		Count[struct{ M int64 `col:"m"` }](),
		Count[struct {
			K int64
		}](),
		Count[Row]())
	fmt.Println("nested",
		Count[struct {
			Rows []struct {
				N int64 `col:"n"`
			}
			By map[string]struct {
				K int `col:"k"`
			}
			Ptr *struct {
				Q int `col:"q"`
			}
		}]())
	fmt.Println("empty",
		Count[struct{}](),
		Count[struct {
		}](),
		Count[struct{ Unit struct{} }]())
}
